title: Union Minister Smt. Annpurna Devi Hails 10 Years of UPI as an Example of India's Digital Revolution
body_text:
Union Minister of Women and Child Development, Smt. Annpurna Devi has hailed the completion of 10 years of the Unified Payments Interface (UPI).
In a post on ‘X’ the Union Minister said that the 10-year journey of UPI has become such an example of the digital revolution that it has made India a new power of digital payments before the world.
UPI के 10 साल का सफर, डिजिटल क्रांति की ऐसी मिसाल बना, जिसने भारत को दुनिया के सामने डिजिटल भुगतान की नई शक्ति बना दिया। #10YearsOfUPI pic.twitter.com/sC2irOInDW — Annpurna Devi (@Annapurna4BJP) August 25, 2026
****
SS

ministry.name: Ministry of Women and Child Development

enrichment.summary: Union Minister for Women and Child Development Smt. Annpurna Devi posted on 'X' celebrating the completion of 10 years of the Unified Payments Interface (UPI), calling it a symbol of India's digital revolution that has established the country as a global leader in digital payments. The release contains only her congratulatory social media message with no new policy announcement.
enrichment.context: UPI, launched by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) in 2016, has become the backbone of India's digital payments ecosystem, processing billions of transactions monthly and being cited internationally as a model for real-time payment systems, including its export to countries like Sri Lanka, UAE, France and Singapore under India's digital public infrastructure diplomacy. However, this particular release is merely a ministerial tweet marking the anniversary and does not introduce any new scheme, data, or policy measure.
